description: A community SDK implementation of the native Media Player widget using Windows media sessions, live cover art, adaptive colors and playback control.

required.reason: Runs the packaged PowerShell provider with the current Windows user's permissions so it can use Windows media APIs and cache album artwork.
Reads the active Windows media session title, artist, playback state, source application and thumbnail.
Toggles play and pause only when the user presses the widget's playback button.
Uses the public Global System Media Transport Controls WinRT API exposed by Windows.
Caches the active session thumbnail in the Taskbar Widgets data directory for native XAML rendering.
Keeps a low-priority provider active while the widget is enabled and checks the media session once per second.

settings.label: Dark appearance
settings.description: Use album-art adaptive dark colors instead of the light media card.
